questions.q: What does the summary say lies behind feeling stuck in a rut?
a: An underlying fear of failure
A lack of clear goals
Too many competing options
A shortage of mentors
questions.why: Lesson 1 says the rut usually hides a fear of failing.

questions.q: How does the summary describe success?
a: It comes from seizing opportunities more than perfect planning
It follows a rigid multi-year plan
It depends mostly on luck
It requires removing every risk
questions.why: Lesson 1 says a winning mentality matters more than rigorous planning.

questions.q: How does failure help you, according to the summary?
a: Analyzing mistakes builds skills for later attempts
It proves your goal was unrealistic
It teaches you to avoid new challenges
It lowers other people's expectations
questions.why: Lesson 2 says reviewing each failure improves your soft skills.

questions.q: What makes a goal more achievable?
a: Binding it to a deadline and splitting it into steps
Keeping it private until it is done
Setting the bar as high as possible
Reviewing it only once a year
questions.why: Lesson 3 recommends small objectives and a firm deadline.

Failing as often as you possibly can
Ignoring the outcome entirely
Changing goals after each setback
questions.why: Lesson 3 says failing only teaches when you study the gaps.
